_comment: STAGING ONLY. quickeasysoftware.com is still served by the live WordPress host
(nginx, wp-json, third-party CloudFront) — not by this AWS account. There is no
Route 53 hosted zone and no CloudFront distribution for the domain here, so the
cutover described in the deployment skill has not happened yet.
No CloudFront in front of this bucket means no create-invalidation step, so the
skill's long immutable asset TTL is not safe for files that change in place.
main.css / main.js keep a short revalidating cache; images and fonts stay
immutable (a changed image gets a new filename).

notes: The exclude list keeps dev artifacts off the public endpoint — they are not pages,
and deploy.config.json in particular should not be readable there. Note that adding
an --exclude does NOT remove a file already in the bucket: sync applies filters to
the destination too, so --delete skips excluded keys. Anything already published has
to be removed with an explicit `aws s3 rm <key>`.
Every page canonicalises to https://quickeasysoftware.com/..., which is what keeps
the public staging endpoint from competing with the live site in search.
